comment: What an assisted session may run beyond a hardened one, on top of allowlist.json (docs/MODES.md). Only `add` is read: commands, public_reads, broker_commands and graphql_mutations, each a list added to the level before. Nothing here can lift a refusal the broker makes in code (owners, files named on the command line, `pr merge --admin`, api writes). Assisted changes only what the agent reads locally, so it adds nothing. Widening this file is a reviewed change.
